task.title: P6-127: Stop manage.revision from rebuilding the whole card table on any tree mutation
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 4 — Correctness, /my collection page, tree and collection header). Original id: P6-127. Size: S. Specs: specs/app-ui.md.

**`manage.revision` as a `view_res` source rebuilds the whole card table on *any* tree mutation, re-seeding every stepper** (was `P6-017c`; `collection.rs:150`). That resurrects the "Undo silently did nothing" defect documented at `collection.rs:236-243` via commit-a-count → tree mutation → Undo from the still-visible toast.
